Flat solid magenta background (#FF00FF) everywhere, no black bars, no white bars, no grid lines, no shadow, no ground, no text, no numbers, no borders, no logos, no effects (no wings, no crown, no fire, no embers, no smoke, no banknotes, no aura, no sparks, no speed lines).
